item.text: {"schema_version":1,"verdict":"changes_requested","findings":[{"finding_id":"f1","severity":"blocking","summary":"Digest equality uses != instead of hmac.compare_digest.","evidence":"release_policy.py:14","claim_ids":["x1"]},{"finding_id":"f2","severity":"blocking","summary":"Paths and roots are never validated; empty, absolute, unnormalized, and backslash-containing values can pass.","evidence":"release_policy.py:16-19; for example, path '/tmp/file' with root '/tmp' returns True.","claim_ids":["x2","x5"]},{"finding_id":"f3","severity":"blocking","summary":"Raw prefix matching permits paths outside a root.","evidence":"release_policy.py:18; root 'services/api' accepts path 'services/api-evil/config.py'.","claim_ids":["x3"]},{"finding_id":"f4","severity":"blocking","summary":"Rename sources are ignored, so an out-of-scope source can be renamed into scope.","evidence":"release_policy.py:18; a rename from 'private/file' to 'docs/file' passes with root 'docs'.","claim_ids":["x4"]},{"finding_id":"f5","severity":"blocking","summary":"Actions and record shape are not checked; unknown actions can pass and missing paths raise an exception instead of returning False.","evidence":"release_policy.py:18; {'action':'unknown','path':'docs/file'} passes with root 'docs', while {'action':'add'} raises KeyError.","claim_ids":["x5"]}]}
